title: Federal Rule 11 — representations and sanctions
summary: Certification and verification requirements attach responsibility to statements submitted to the court. Sanctions can enforce that responsibility but require the applicable substantive standard and procedural protections.

sections.Role in the course: Certification and verification requirements attach responsibility to statements submitted to the court. Sanctions can enforce that responsibility but require the applicable substantive standard and procedural protections.
sections.What to examine: Distinguish derivative-action verification in Surowitz from Rule 11 certification and the court’s other sanctions authority. Identify the document, factual or legal inquiry, alleged misconduct, notice, and procedure for imposing a sanction.
